maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost row of keypoints is situated approximately 1.5 spot-diameters superior to the dense secondary row, following a trajectory that diverges from the nasal midline at an approximate 15-degree angle.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 92% melanin saturation; pink/pale pixels are confined to the inner margins of the nares and a localized, irregular 3-pixel-wide cluster on the superior nasal bridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, circular depigmented spot (likely a minor abrasion) is present on the upper left quadrant of the rhinarium bridge; secondary fine-line vertical scarring is visible on the lower right margin of the nose leather.
other_distinctive_markers: Deeply recessed philtrum creates a high-contrast vertical division between the two primary lobes of the muzzle fur.
